coverage.member: FusionCheckBox(this InputBoundField<TModel, bool> setup, Action<CheckBoxBuilder> build)
coverage.catches: the FusionCheckBox builder stops rendering the model-bound checkboxes (the test asserts the move-in form opens with the agreement box visible and unchecked and the housekeeping box present and locked)

coverage.member: SetDisabled(this ComponentRef<FusionCheckBox, TModel> self, bool disabled)
coverage.catches: SetDisabled stops writing the disabled state (the DomReady SetDisabled(true) is what greys out housekeeping on load; the test asserts the housekeeping box is disabled when the form opens)

the Disabled() source stops yielding the disabled state into its condition (the locked message 'Locked until you accept the residency agreement.' is produced by When(Disabled()).Truthy(); the test asserts that exact message on load)
the Changed event stops firing the reactive handler when the resident accepts the agreement, so housekeeping is never unlocked and the unlocked message never appears
the .Reactive wiring stops connecting the checkbox's Changed event to its plan pipeline, so accepting the agreement runs no reaction and housekeeping stays disabled
the Changed event arg contract stops delivering the change payload into the plan, so the accepted branch never runs and the housekeeping box stays disabled with no unlocked message

Checked stops carrying the state after each change (the test toggles consent on then off and asserts the message follows: 'accepted' on the Truthy branch, 'Please accept' on the Else branch); a stuck Checked would leave the message wrong one way

coverage.member: SetChecked(this ComponentRef<FusionCheckBox, TModel> self, bool isChecked)
coverage.catches: SetChecked stops writing the checked state (the test clicks 'Add our recommended housekeeping' and asserts the housekeeping box becomes checked from unchecked)

coverage.member: SetIndeterminate(this ComponentRef<FusionCheckBox, TModel> self, bool isIndeterminate)
coverage.catches: SetIndeterminate stops writing the indeterminate state (the test clicks 'flag for follow-up' and asserts the housekeeping box shows the EJ2 indeterminate dash)

the Indeterminate() source stops yielding the indeterminate state into its condition (the follow-up message 'A coordinator will follow up with you about weekly housekeeping.' is produced by When(Indeterminate()).Truthy(); the test asserts that exact message)
Click stops invoking the rendered checkbox click (the test clicks 'Toggle weekly housekeeping for me' and asserts the housekeeping box becomes checked from unchecked)
FocusIn stops moving focus into the rendered checkbox (the test clicks 'Take me back to the agreement' and asserts the agreement checkbox input is the focused element)
the Checked() source stops yielding the agreement state into the gather body (the test asserts the POST carries "agreementAccepted":true)
